mapper.select: SELECT eoi.id, eoi.exchange_id, eoi.sku_id, eoi.sku_code, eoi.sku_name, ps.size_value AS size_value, ps.image AS image, eoi.quantity, eoi.unit_price, eoi.quality_status, eoi.item_type, eoi.created_at FROM exchange_order_item eoi LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON eoi.sku_id = ps.id AND ps.deleted = 0 WHERE eoi.exchange_id = #{exchangeId} ORDER BY eoi.id ASC

SELECT eoi.id, eoi.exchange_id, eoi.sku_id, eoi.sku_code, eoi.sku_name, ps.size_value AS size_value, ps.image AS image, eoi.quantity, eoi.unit_price, eoi.quality_status, eoi.item_type, eoi.created_at FROM exchange_order_item eoi LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON eoi.sku_id = ps.id AND ps.deleted = 0 WHERE eoi.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exchange_order_item (exchange_id, sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, quantity, unit_price, item_type) VALUES (#{exchangeId}, #{skuId}, #{skuCode}, #{skuName}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{itemType})
